import HartshorneLib.Chapter4HigherPoleResidue
import HartshorneLib.Chapter4LocalTaylorDerivation

/-!
# Taylor coefficients of differential coordinates on a curve

The coordinate of `da` in the frame `dt` differentiates the local Taylor
coefficients of `a`. The parameter is specified throughout and the identity
holds in arbitrary characteristic. This supplies a local calculation for
Hartshorne III.7.14.1.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory AlgebraicGeometry IsLocalRing

namespace Hartshorne

noncomputable section

attribute [local instance] functionFieldOverAlgebra stalkOverAlgebra
  stalkFunctionFieldOver_isScalarTower

variable {k : Type u} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k]
variable (X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) [IsIntegral X.left]
  [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 X.hom]

/-- Differentiation in the frame of a specified local parameter. -/
def curveParameterDerivation {x : X.left} (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X.left)
    (t : X.left.presheaf.stalk x) (ht : Irreducible t) :
    Derivation k (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) :=
  (curveStalkDifferentialEquivOfIrreducible X hx t ht).symm.compDer
    (KaehlerDifferential.D k (X.left.presheaf.stalk x))

@[simp]
theorem curveParameterDerivation_apply {x : X.left} (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X.left)
    (t : X.left.presheaf.stalk x) (ht : Irreducible t)
    (a : X.left.presheaf.stalk x) :
    curveParameterDerivation X hx t ht a =
      (curveStalkDifferentialEquivOfIrreducible X hx t ht).symm
        (KaehlerDifferential.D k (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) a) := rfl

@[simp]
theorem curveParameterDerivation_parameter {x : X.left} (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X.left)
    (t : X.left.presheaf.stalk x) (ht : Irreducible t) :
    curveParameterDerivation X hx t ht t = 1 := by
  apply (curveStalkDifferentialEquivOfIrreducible X hx t ht).injective
  simp

/-- The Taylor coefficients of the actual local differential coordinate
obey the formal derivative rule. -/
theorem curveLocalTaylorCoefficient_differentialCoordinate
    {x : X.left} (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X.left)
    (t : X.left.presheaf.stalk x) (ht : Irreducible t)
    (n : ℕ) (a : X.left.presheaf.stalk x) :
    letI := smoothCurve_stalk_isDiscreteValuationRing X.hom hx
    localTaylorCoefficient (curveParameterConstantTerm X hx)
        (curveParameterConstantTerm_residue X hx) t ht.ne_zero ht.maximalIdeal_eq n
        ((curveStalkDifferentialEquivOfIrreducible X hx t ht).symm
          (KaehlerDifferential.D k (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) a)) =
      (n + 1 : k) * localTaylorCoefficient (curveParameterConstantTerm X hx)
        (curveParameterConstantTerm_residue X hx) t ht.ne_zero ht.maximalIdeal_eq (n + 1) a := by
  letI := smoothCurve_stalk_isDiscreteValuationRing X.hom hx
  exact localTaylorCoefficient_derivation (curveParameterConstantTerm X hx)
    (curveParameterConstantTerm_residue X hx) t ht.ne_zero ht.maximalIdeal_eq
    (curveParameterDerivation X hx t ht) (curveParameterDerivation_parameter X hx t ht) n a

end
end Hartshorne
